# Valid Code Block Examples

Simple code block:

```
console.log("Hello World");
```

Code block with language:

```javascript
function greet(name) {
    return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}
```

Python example:

```python
def hello():
    print("Hello World")
```

Multiple code blocks work fine:

```bash
echo "First block"
```

```bash
echo "Second block"
```
